description: Public holidays for 100+ countries (optionally one state/region) and business-day math in one call: list holidays for a year, add or subtract N business days, check if a date is a business day, or count business days between two dates, skipping weekends (configurable, e.g. fri,sat) and public holidays. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/holidays-business-days

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB, DE

days.description: Business days to add for op=add (negative subtracts, max +/-1000)

subdivision.description: ISO 3166-2 region to include regional holidays, e.g. US-CA, DE-BY

weekend.description: Weekend days, comma-separated (default sat,sun; e.g. fri,sat) or none

name: holidays_business_days
title: Holidays Business Days
